title.en: An Act Naming the Bridge Linking the Municipalities of Bustos and Baliuag, all in the Province of Bulacan, as the General Alejo S. Santos Bridge
title.orig: An Act Naming the Bridge Linking the Municipalities of Bustos and Baliuag, all in the Province of Bulacan, as the General Alejo S. Santos Bridge

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6762_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bridge linking the Municipalities of Bustos and Baliuag, all in the Province of Bulacan, is hereby named as the General Alejo S. Santos Bridge.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in two (2) national newspapers of general circulation.
